project.name: Job Intelligence Platform
project.description: Personal career intelligence platform for discovering, normalizing, evaluating, tracking and analyzing jobs.

items.title: Canonical Job / Job Listing separation
items.description: Model a canonical Job independently from the individual listings that publish or distribute it.
acceptance: A Job can have multiple Job Listings.
Listing provenance remains attached to the listing.
Canonical job data is not duplicated per source.

items.title: Define Job Source as the publishing entity
items.description: Use Job Source as the stable product term for LinkedIn, Indeed, company careers, newsletters, and similar channels.
acceptance: Source type is separate from collection capability.

items.title: Separate Acquisition Method from Job Source
items.description: Record how JobIntel discovered a listing independently from where it was published.
acceptance: Crawler, Universal Search, Browser Companion, Email, and Manual are represented.

items.title: Preserve Found via and Applied via
items.description: Applications record discovery channel separately from the channel used to submit the application.
acceptance: Source analytics do not conflate them.

items.title: Protected Unclassified Source
items.description: Use a stable protected source when publishing provenance is initially unknown.
acceptance: Unknown discoveries have a stable source.

items.title: Organization separated from Job Source
items.description: Organizations such as companies and schools are modeled independently from publishing channels.
acceptance: Organization and Job Source support many-to-many relationships.

items.title: Create, edit and maintain Job Sources
items.description: Maintain source metadata with normalized domain identity.

items.title: Safe Job Source URL verification
items.description: Verify URLs with redirects, timeouts, HTTP status handling, and SSRF protections.

items.title: Collection capability classification
items.description: Represent crawlable, restricted, manual, search, email and related collection capabilities.
acceptance: Restricted sources can use alternative collection methods.

items.title: Source lifecycle and risk states
items.description: Support source edit/delete/archive behavior and risk classification.

items.title: Crawler configuration management
items.description: Configure recurring collection jobs per crawlable Job Source.
acceptance: Configurations are grouped by Job Source.

items.title: Crawler sessions and history
items.description: Track active sessions, completed runs, failures, pauses and counts.

items.title: Restricted-source collection policy
items.description: Classify protected sources and use permitted alternatives rather than bypassing protections.
acceptance: Restricted sources are not forced through brittle crawling.

items.title: Recurring scheduled discovery
items.description: Run enabled crawlers repeatedly, including the intended four-hour collection cycle.

items.title: Freshness and recently-added tracking
items.description: Distinguish recent jobs from old listings and surface newly discovered opportunities.

items.title: Universal Search
items.description: Search across external discovery channels without automatically turning results into engaged jobs.
acceptance: Search results remain separate from engaged Jobs.

items.title: Discovery Archive
items.description: Store Universal Search results as user-specific records with review states.
acceptance: To Review, Saved to Jobs, and Dismissed states exist.
Original query and acquisition context are retained.

items.title: Promote discovery to engaged Job
items.description: Save a discovery into the main Jobs workflow without losing provenance.

items.title: Later source classification
items.description: Allow an initially unclassified discovery to be attached to a known Job Source.

items.title: Normalize Job Listing URLs
items.description: Normalize listing URLs so equivalent representations can be detected.

items.title: LinkedIn currentJobId canonicalization
items.description: Recognize LinkedIn search-result URLs containing currentJobId and canonicalize the underlying job.

items.title: Browser Companion duplicate protection
items.description: Check uniqueness in the extension while keeping the backend authoritative for race safety.

items.title: Historical URL integrity backfill
items.description: Normalize and repair historical URLs after uniqueness rules are introduced.

items.title: Application pipeline and stage history
items.description: Track applications through applied, screening, interview, offer, rejection, withdrawal, no-response and closure stages.
acceptance: Table and pipeline use the same state.

items.title: Application provenance
items.description: Store Search Profile, exact CV version, Found via, Applied via, notes and application metadata.
acceptance: Found via and Applied via remain separate.

items.title: Application filters and pipeline views
items.description: Provide table and pipeline views with stage filters.
acceptance: Applied, Interviewing, Rejected and Offers can be filtered.

items.title: CV upload and versioning
items.description: Maintain immutable original CV sources and versioned prepared CV artifacts.
acceptance: Search Profiles can select default CVs.

items.title: CV-to-job comparison
items.description: Compare a CV against job requirements and identify evidence, gaps, partial matches and confirmation-needed items.

items.title: Truthful CV tailoring
items.description: Suggest targeted CV improvements without inventing experience, credentials, dates, employers or achievements.
acceptance: Unsupported claims are not presented as facts.

items.title: Template-preserving arbitrary DOCX editing
items.description: Complete true arbitrary-template-preserving editing rather than relying only on retained originals and generated exports.
acceptance: Export can be compared with the original.

items.title: Job page detection and extraction
items.description: Detect supported job pages and extract vacancy information for review.
acceptance: Title and description are extracted where available.

items.title: CV selection and comparison in extension
items.description: Select a prepared CV and compare it with the detected job.
acceptance: Comparison and gaps are available before saving.

items.title: Exact Save and Save + Applied flows
items.description: Provide explicit save and save-plus-application actions.

items.title: Production extension host configuration
items.description: Use production API configuration and safe token management.
acceptance: Local and production settings remain separate.

items.title: Share one or many jobs by email
items.description: Share selected jobs through a configured webhook/email flow with client fallback.
acceptance: Webhook can be used when configured.

items.title: Deep-link notifications
items.description: Notification clicks navigate directly to the relevant Job, Application or Job Source.

items.title: Multi-profile search configuration
items.description: Support role/geography profiles with keywords, exclusions, locations, categories, remote-only, freshness and expiry rules.
acceptance: Crawler/search operations can use a selected profile.

items.title: Dashboard and operational reporting
items.description: Provide dashboard views for discovery, jobs, applications, interviews, offers, risk and system health.

items.title: Source contribution and effectiveness reporting
items.description: Measure discovery contribution, applications, response/interview/offer conversion, duplicates, stale jobs and source health without conflating provenance.
acceptance: Publishing source and acquisition remain distinct.

items.title: Application Pack
items.description: Bundle job snapshot, exact CV version, cover letter, application answers, recruiter/contact data, notes and interview material.
acceptance: The pack reconstructs what was submitted.

items.title: Achievement / Evidence Bank
items.description: Maintain confirmed career evidence reusable for truthful CV tailoring, cover letters, applications and interviews.
acceptance: AI suggestions can reference confirmed evidence.

items.title: Cover letter intelligence
items.description: Generate job-specific cover letters from confirmed CV evidence and job requirements.
acceptance: Claims are grounded in confirmed evidence.

items.title: Application form assistant
items.description: Assist with repetitive application questions using confirmed profile and job context.

items.title: Interview workspace
items.description: Prepare interview context from the exact job, application pack, CV evidence, notes and interview history.
acceptance: Interview material is tied to the application.

items.title: Recruiter/contact CRM
items.description: Track recruiters and hiring contacts, relationships, notes and application associations.

items.title: Follow-up engine
items.description: Track follow-up dates, reminders, responses and communication history.

items.title: Skill-gap intelligence across jobs
items.description: Aggregate repeated job requirements to identify recurring skills and evidence gaps.

items.title: Market intelligence
items.description: Analyze demand by role, location, work mode, source, organization, salary where available and recurring requirements.

items.title: Application strategy experiments
items.description: Track changes to search/application strategies and their observed outcomes descriptively.
acceptance: Applications can be associated with a strategy.

items.title: Opportunity review queue
items.description: Provide a transparent review queue using configurable freshness, fit, risk, source and user-defined criteria.

items.title: Offer management
items.description: Track offer details, deadlines, compensation components, negotiation notes and final decision.

items.title: React + RTK Query production architecture
items.description: Move shared server state toward Redux Toolkit/RTK Query and feature-oriented modules.

items.title: Preserve approved visual shell
items.description: Keep the dark navy operational shell, dense sidebar, master-detail layouts and progressive disclosure while improving maintainability.
acceptance: No unintended reversion to older UI.

items.title: Discovery Archive navigation
items.description: Expose Discovery Archive as a dedicated navigation destination while keeping raw search results out of All Jobs.
acceptance: All Jobs does not automatically contain raw Universal Search results.

items.title: Prisma production migration strategy
items.description: Baseline/squash legacy development migrations when needed and use migrate deploy in production.
acceptance: Migration is tested on a disposable DB.

items.title: Production deployment topology
items.description: Deploy frontend, API, worker and PostgreSQL as separate production responsibilities.
acceptance: API and worker are independently deployable.

items.title: Production domains, cookies and CORS
items.description: Validate secure cookies, CORS, CSRF considerations and extension API configuration for production.

items.title: Health checks and worker observability
items.description: Expose API health/readiness and make background worker failures visible.

items.title: CI validation pipeline
items.description: Run type checks, tests, Prisma generation, builds and migration validation before production deployment.
acceptance: Pull requests fail on validation errors.

items.title: Product and architecture documentation
items.description: Maintain domain glossary, flows, architecture decisions, deployment instructions, crawler policy and testing checklists.
acceptance: New developers can understand the core model.

items.title: GitHub Project as code
items.description: Keep the roadmap manifest in the repository and synchronize issues/project items through the GitHub API.
